name: Santa Cruz de Grío (Spain)
description: Yellow field with a blue triangle from the hoist continued by a blue cross of Lorraine, the hoist charged with a yellow crozier and palm.
history: Municipal flag of Santa Cruz de Grío; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: triangle with its base at the hoist
double cross of Lorraine extending from the triangle
crozier and palm on the triangle
